notes: Hardening I adoption rows preserved (13 CASH → CH-CASH-01..10). Hardening II Adoption Gate adopts CC-CH-ACC-001..015 into CH-ACC-01..13. ACC-009 and ACC-015 reconciled into CH-ACC-08 (Art. 6 spine + FINMA corroboration). ACC-001/006 and ACC-002/012 kept distinct (AMLA vs CDB operational limbs). CH-ACC-05/11/12/13 unbound. Bindings added only for rules.resident_holding_rules and rules.non_resident_rules (total bindings 6). No resident/non-resident entitlement claims; no generic prior-approval negative; no transfer-freedom claims. M2.5 adoption_eligible remains false. Does not draft switzerland.json. No Hardening III.

adoptions.rationale: Fresh project judgment: FOCBS unrestricted quantitative carriage into/through/out is a standalone verified/E1 proposition. Scope limited to absence of quantitative carriage ceiling under the FOCBS border-cash framework. Forbidden inferences block no-controls / no-AML / no-seizure overreads. Bound to traveler summary and entry/exit carriage fields. Not a mechanical map from M2.5 supported→verified.

Fresh project judgment: M2.5 reviewed_text is the semantic source for the negative no-spontaneous-FOCBS-declaration claim. Project status verified (not mapped from M2.5 bounded) because the primary FOCBS statement directly supports the negative and forbidden inferences are strong. Bound into traveler summary, entry/exit, and cash_declaration_threshold. No-declaration ≠ no-control.

Fresh project judgment: truthful-information-when-questioned remains independently useful after reconciliation. Trigger 'during a check' preserved; not transformed into proactive declaration. Bound to traveler summary and threshold architecture fields.

Reconciled into CH-CASH-04. FOCBS public >=CHF10k inquiry package establishes the same material proposition as Ordinance Art. 3 Abs. 1 (CC-CH-CASH-009). Legal text is the semantic spine; FOCBS guidance is supporting public/current corroboration cited on the same project claim. No second project claim minted. Fingerprint retained for Adoption history.

Fresh project judgment: >=CHF10k FOCBS information-system entry is materially distinct from inquiry (CH-CASH-04) and from Art. 6 Meldung (CH-CASH-10). Kept as standalone verified/E1 operational claim. Not called statistical recording, AML report, or declaration.

Reconciled into CH-CASH-08. FOCBS refusal/false-information customs-offence guidance overlaps Art. 5 lit. a–b (CC-CH-CASH-012). Ordinance lit. a–b controls operative scope; FOCBS wording is supporting representation only and must not broaden beyond lit. a–b. No duplicate offence claim.

Reconciled into CH-CASH-07. FOCBS temporary seizure / police handover is the same provisional-seizure mechanism as Ordinance Art. 4 (CC-CH-CASH-011). One canonical claim; temporary and provisional are not separate claims. Suspicion trigger and amount-independence preserved; not threshold-driven.

Fresh project judgment: Art. 2 Barmittel definition adopted verified/E0 for category fidelity but left unbound so traveler fields are not turned into a statutory-definition recital. German legal basis preserved; English rule is project rendering only, not unofficial English authority.

Fresh project judgment: Art. 3 Abs. 1 is the legal spine for the canonical >=CHF10k inquiry/information package (CH-CASH-04, verified/E0). Preserves mindestens CHF 10,000, identity, origin/source, intended use, beneficial owner, express-questioning trigger. CC-CH-CASH-004 reconciled into this claim. Forbidden: declaration threshold, carriage ceiling, permit, automatic suspicion.

Fresh project judgment: Art. 3 Abs. 2 below-threshold suspicion inquiry is strategically distinct — prevents 'below CHF 10,000 = outside customs control'. Exact ML/TF suspicion condition preserved. Bound into traveler summary and cash_declaration_threshold wording architecture.

Fresh project judgment: Art. 4 provisional seizure is the legal spine for CH-CASH-07 (verified/E0). Amount-independent; ML/TF suspicion context; provisional only. CC-CH-CASH-007 FOCBS temporary-seizure guidance reconciled into this claim. Bound carefully so cash_declaration_threshold does not read as seizure-on-threshold.

Fresh project judgment: Art. 5 lit. a–b refusal/false-information offence is the legal spine for CH-CASH-08 (verified/E0). Scope limited exactly to lit. a–b. CC-CH-CASH-006 FOCBS guidance reconciled as supporting representation. Bound to cash_declaration_threshold; traveler summary not overloaded with penalty detail.

Fresh project judgment: Art. 6 Abs. 2 amount-independent Meldung adopted as bounded/E1 and unbound. M2.5 reviewed_text retained as German operative rule. Actor/recipient/trigger semantics are insufficient for safe traveler drafting. Binding into cash_declaration_threshold would risk false inference of amount-independent traveler declaration. Distinct from CH-CASH-05 FOCBS information-system entry. Forbidden: Meldung = traveller declaration; traveler must declare regardless of amount.
Fresh project judgment: AMLA Art. 3 para. 1 contracting-party identity is verified/E0. KYC ≠ entitlement. Bound to resident/non-resident fields as compliance condition only.
Fresh project judgment: AMLA Art. 4 beneficial-owner identify+verify is verified/E0. Distinct from CDB Art. 27 statement mechanics (CH-ACC-04).
Fresh project judgment: AMLA Art. 5 doubt-triggered repetition is verified/E0. Distinct from Art. 7 para. 1bis periodic update.
Fresh project judgment: AMLA Art. 6 para. 2 is the legal spine for conditional enhanced clarification (CH-ACC-08, verified/E0). ACC-009 and ACC-015 reconcile into this claim as FINMA corroboration.
Fresh project judgment: AMLA Art. 7 para. 1bis risk-based periodic record update is verified/E0. Not continuous re-identification.

Fresh project judgment: CDB Art. 4 bank account/securities-account opening identity is verified/E1 and kept distinct from AMLA Art. 3 general FI duty (CH-ACC-01). Actor scope = banks/CDB — not all intermediaries.
Fresh project judgment: CDB Art. 20 controlling-person identification adopted verified/E1 but unbound — too technical for resident/non-resident public surfaces; retained as fidelity guardrail.
Fresh project judgment: CDB Art. 7 domicile documentation adopted verified/E1 unbound. Data requirement ≠ residence account class; public fields do not need this documentary detail.

Reconciled into CH-ACC-08. FINMA heightened-risk recording/clarification is a supervisory manifestation of the same conditional enhanced-clarification architecture as AMLA Art. 6. No second claim. Non-resident ≠ high-risk class preserved in forbidden inferences.

Fresh project judgment: FINMA institutional risk-tolerance boundary adopted as bounded/E1 (supervisory institutional expectation, not statutory ban). Bound to defeat legacy 'freely' without inventing a national prohibition.

Fresh project judgment: high-risk source-of-assets clarification and higher-risk transaction monitoring adopted as bounded/E1 and kept distinct from CH-ACC-08 baseline Art. 6 triggers. Not universal foreign SoW.
Fresh project judgment: CDB Art. 27 bank BO statement on account opening is verified/E1 and kept distinct from AMLA Art. 4 general BO duty (CH-ACC-03).
Fresh project judgment: 1 October 2026 revised AMLA/transparency EIF adopted unbound as verified temporal/future fact. Not current on 2026-09-09. No current-field binding.
Fresh project judgment: AMLO-FINMA May 2026 consultation adopted unbound as bounded temporal process claim. Consultation ≠ adopted current ordinance. No current-field binding.
Reconciled into CH-ACC-08. FINMA unusual/crime-TF clarification overlaps AMLA Art. 6 conditional clarification architecture. Retained as supporting supervisory representation — no duplicate claim.
